Title: Azure Container Registry tag locking policy is now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry tag locking policy allows for building a trusted workflow. As images are built and pushed to a registry, deployments depend on a given tag. When a container image is deployed to production, having an immutable container image that can't be accidentally deleted or overwritten can increase the stability of deployments.

Learn more
